simple.meaning: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise ); by implication, to blunt ; figuratively, to destroy
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מוּל (H4135) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
